description: This file defines a timezone-aware Date object (`timezoneJS.Date`) with support for Olson timezone data, including methods for serialization, timezone calculations, and zone data parsing. It also includes a timezone management object (`timezoneJS.timezone`) for loading and handling timezone zoneinfo files.
external_files: possibly jQuery, Zepto, fleegix (for AJAX transport)

classes.name: timezoneJS.Date
classes.description: A constructor function that mimics the native JavaScript Date object but adds full timezone support, serialization, and extended date manipulation features.

methods.name: getTzInfo
methods.description: Retrieves timezone offset and abbreviation for a given date and timezone.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats the date into a string with support for custom formats and timezone adjustments.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object, preserving timezone info.
